task_name: World 127 Task A  -  SaaS Cumulative Ratable Ceiling Trap, ASC 606-10-25-12 Prospective Modification & Uncompleted UAT Milestone
prompt: Review the chart of accounts and ASC 606 revenue policy, SaaS subscription contracts, modification addenda, implementation milestones, and October 2026 general ledger postings for CloudPulse Analytics Inc. in cloudpulse_oct2026_saas_mod_and_asc340_commissions.xlsx. Audit each active subscription and implementation arrangement from its opening October 1, 2026 deferred revenue balance through October 31, 2026; evaluate any cumulative elapsed-month recognition errors, mid-term contract modifications under ASC 606-10-25-12, and uncompleted customer UAT milestones; provide the required adjusting journal entries; and reconcile unadjusted to audited October 2026 subscription revenue, implementation revenue, total revenue, and ending deferred revenue by contract and in total.

rubric.description: Audits enterprise subscription SAAS-401 (Northstar Bio, 12-month $144,000.00 contract from 2026-09-01 to 2027-08-31 at $12,000.00 per month with $12,000.00 recognized in 2026-09 and $132,000.00 opening 2400 Deferred Revenue on 2026-10-01), identifying that JE-1041 booked the 2-month cumulative elapsed amount of $24,000.00 to October 2026-10 4100 Subscription Revenue (overstating cumulative recognized revenue at $36,000.00 and reducing SAAS-401 unadjusted 2400 to $108,000.00).

Provides the correcting journal entry on SAAS-401 to reverse the double-recognized September revenue: Dr 4100 Subscription Revenue $12,000.00 / Cr 2400 Deferred Revenue $12,000.00, restoring October 2026-10 revenue on SAAS-401 to $12,000.00 and ending 2400 Deferred Revenue on SAAS-401 to $120,000.00 across 10 remaining months.

Evaluates Vanguard Logistics contract SAAS-402 ($72,000.00 original 12-month subscription from 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30 at $6,000.00 per month, $18,000.00 recognized Jul-Sep, and $54,000.00 opening 2400 Deferred Revenue on 2026-10-01) and 2026-10-01 modification MOD-402-01 ($27,000.00 incremental billing for integrated seat and tier expansion discounted below standalone selling price across the 9 remaining months 2026-10-01 to 2027-06-30), computing an $81,000.00 prospective unrecognized revenue pool and a $9,000.00 per month prospective recognition rate under ASC 606-10-25-12.

Identifies that October 2026-10 postings on SAAS-402 recognized $33,000.00 in 4100 Subscription Revenue ($6,000.00 base amortization on JE-1042 plus $27,000.00 upfront modification cash on DEP-402-MOD, leaving $48,000.00 unadjusted in 2400), overstating October revenue on SAAS-402 by $24,000.00 relative to the $9,000.00 earned rate ($6,000.00 base plus $3,000.00 expansion).

Provides the ASC 606-10-25-12 adjusting journal entry for SAAS-402: Dr 4100 Subscription Revenue $24,000.00 / Cr 2400 Deferred Revenue $24,000.00, restoring SAAS-402 October 4100 Subscription Revenue to $9,000.00 and ending 2400 Deferred Revenue to $72,000.00 across 8 remaining months (refusing immediate upfront recognition or retrospective catch-up to closed Jul-Sep periods).

Identifies that Aegis Health custom HIPAA SSO integration milestone IMP-403 ($18,000.00 billed and collected on 2026-10-15 via DEP-403-IMP in 4200 Implementation Revenue) had 0.00% customer delivery in 2026-10 because signed Production UAT acceptance occurred on 2026-11-12, requiring 100.00% deferral ($18,000.00) with $0.00 October implementation revenue.

Provides the adjusting journal entry for uncompleted milestone IMP-403: Dr 4200 Implementation Revenue $18,000.00 / Cr 2400 Deferred Revenue $18,000.00, refusing partial over-time recognition prior to signed customer UAT acceptance.

Reconciles CloudPulse Analytics Inc. October 2026-10 revenue from $75,000.00 unadjusted ($57,000.00 in 4100 Subscription Revenue and $18,000.00 in 4200 Implementation Revenue) down by $54,000.00 total deferrals to $21,000.00 audited ($21,000.00 in 4100 and $0.00 in 4200), and reconciles ending 2400 Deferred Revenue at 2026-10-31 from $156,000.00 unadjusted to $210,000.00 audited ($120,000.00 SAAS-401 + $72,000.00 SAAS-402 + $18,000.00 IMP-403).
